lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns; two distinct columns of four spots each are visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the lateral spots; blobs are centered within these vertical bands, creating a structured grid-like alignment across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, dominant horizontal feature across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial frequency of smaller high-luminance spots, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
